title: Uncovering the impact of battery design parameters on health and lifetime using short charging segments
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,8462-8474
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE03268G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wendi Guo, Søren Byg Vilsen, Yaqi Li, Ashima Verma, Daniel Ioan Stroe, Daniel Brandell
Battery design is linked to real-world applications using a battery-design-aware machine learning framework built on a digital twin model, ultimately contributing to safer and longer-lasting next-generation batteries.
